rules-interference.title: Who yields?

cases.situation: A station is operating illegally. May you jam it?
Amateurs are secondary on a band. A primary user complains.
cases.why: Secondary users must not interfere with primary users.

cases.situation: An Advanced operator wants the frequency a Basic operator is using.
cases.why: Both have an equal right to the frequency.

options: Only if they won't interfere with anyone
cases.answer: Only if they won't interfere with anyone
cases.why: No interference to amateurs or other services.

rules-interference.success: No deliberate interference ever, yield to primary users, and share fairly with other amateurs.
